scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile=false && node scripts/run_python.mjs -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.analytics:build: node scripts/run_python.mjs -m dbt.cli.main build --project-dir analytics --profiles-dir analytics
scripts.test:api: node scripts/run_python.mjs -m pytest services/api/tests connectors/tests scripts/tests -q
scripts.test:analytics: node scripts/run_python.mjs -m dbt.cli.main build --project-dir analytics --profiles-dir analytics
scripts.test: pnpm data:generate && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:analytics && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm release:check
